breaking.change: The inked-comic-3d look's ui is the new `@themes/comic` pack (charcoal panels under an ink rim, slanted yellow slabs, a hand-drawn arrow, Bangers capitals), no longer `@themes/ink`; the neon-vector look's is the new `@themes/neon` pack (glowing cyan line frames on black, Orbitron capitals), no longer `@themes/scifi`.
breaking.fix: A game that wants the old UI on these looks writes `ui: "@themes/ink"` or `ui: "@themes/scifi"` in its look.

breaking.change: The packs dress the built-in controls with drawn nine-slice parts (frames, plates, buttons and their pressed faces, the current menu entry, a cursor, tabs, slider and switch pieces, checkboxes, bar frames) and their own display faces, instead of recoloured token slots. pixel is carved wood around parchment in the light scheme; minimal sets Jost; candy is light white plastic with Titan One; cartoon sets Luckiest Guy and Nunito. Their inks are the parts' own (`part-fg`, `part-on`, `part-gold`).
breaking.fix: A game's own components on these packs read `text-part-fg` on a part and draw a part with its class (`nine-panel`, `nine-plate`, `nine-button`); a game that wanted the former look extends its own theme from the dimensions it used.
